exposure: type of healthcare provider at last ANC visit
outcome: presentation in labor with multiple c-section scars
cohort: 275 pregnant women who underwent C-section due to multiple uterine scars in the Mwanza region of Tanzania.
finding: Presenting in active labor with multiple c-section scars was associated with having the last ANC visit at a primary healthcare facility, unemployment, fewer than four ANC visits, and being attended by a non-physician health provider at the last ANC visit.
